notes.title: Our new game!
notes.content:
"Polygon of Reality" is a horror game in which you will have to unravel the mysteries of other dimensions and a research complex. Descend into the complex buried in the ground, uncover the mysteries of what happened, meet with forgotten fears and unknown creatures.

notes.title: New Update: Gaming Improvements and Fixes
notes.content:
New Update: Gaming Improvements and Fixes

Dear players,

We are pleased to announce the recent update to our game, which brings a range of enhancements and fixes to make your gaming experience even more enjoyable and hassle-free. Here's a brief overview of what awaits you:

Fixed Korean Language Display Issue:
We have successfully resolved the issue related to the display of the Korean language in the game. Now our Korean players can enjoy the game without any disturbances or translation inconsistencies.

Project Optimization Improved:
We have implemented a series of optimizations to make the gaming process even smoother and faster. Enjoy the game without delays or inefficient use of your device's resources.

Fixed a number of notes discrepancies:
We also addressed notes in the game and fixed a number of minor issues to make their use more convenient and safe for you. Now your gaming experience will become even more comprehensive.

Several minor fixes:
In this update, we have also implemented several minor fixes aimed at improving the overall gaming experience and increasing the stability of the game.

Thank you for your support and feedback! Keep enjoying the game, and remember that we always strive to make it even better for you. See you in the game!

notes.title: RELEASE
notes.content:
So we have come a long way from the beginning of the development of the first game to the final publication. ✔️
We are glad that we have come this long way with you and would like to thank you for your support. ❣️

notes.title: We're on the final development path!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We want to thank you very much for your interest in our game and adding it to your wishlist! Your support and enthusiasm inspire our team and confirm that we are on the right track.

We are working tirelessly to create an unforgettable gaming experience for you. Every member of our team is full of energy and enthusiasm to make "IFU" the most exciting horror game you have ever played.

We want to assure you that the development and testing of the game is in full swing. We are working hard to offer you unique puzzles, atmosphere and story that will leave you speechless with excitement.

Stay tuned for our updates because we will be releasing "IFU" soon! We can't wait for you to dive into this exciting world.

Once again, thank you so much for your support and trust. We appreciate each and every one of you and are ready to give you an unforgettable experience.

Best wishes,
Setone Games development team.
